worldwide

worldwide

immediately

Dear RC-OM Team,
As per indicated by SichargeD Product Champion in the email loop, I am writing you in ticket

to provide you with guidelines on how to shutdown the charger.
There are two ways to shutdown the charger, according to whether the HMI is working or not.
Shutdown from HMI:
Open the front door of the charger.
Once the front door is open, and the LEDs are turning red, you should see on the HMI the following screen:
Press "ShutDown"
Wait for the charger to switch off
Once the charger is switched off, complete the procedure by switching off breaker QA2. You can find the breaker, highlighted in yellow, in the bottom area of the charger:
Close the door
HW Shutdown:
in case the HMI is not working properly, and it is not possible to press the "Shutdown" button as per picture above, please proceed with the following steps:
Open the front door of the charger
Put the black dip-switch of PLC (KF1) into STOP position
Press FC12 and switch it off
Switch off QA2 (same as instructions above)
Close the door
You can reach out to me in case you need further support.
